title: Fun afternoon!!
text: Beautiful day for a e-bike ride. Richard was informative and had a sense of humour. Spoke English well so was easy to understand. We were lucky enough that we were the only two in the tour! Great bike ride. Very easy for us (67 & 71 yr old).
author: need2sun

title: Excellent bike tour!
text: Richard was an excellent guide. We went all over the city, where he explained the background and history of each place we visited. He was very patient with me as a nervous biker-I hadn’t ridden a bike since I was a child and never an e-bike. We really enjoyed this tour with Richard. We highly recommend!
author: Wendy_F

title: First class, great e-bikes, great tour guide
text: This tour was exceptional! Our guide, Gaspar, was extremely knowledgeable as he is a PhD student studying Spanish history and culture. His English was fabulous, and he really oriented us to the beauty of this city. I would highly recommend this company, and Gaspar, as the best tour in Seville!
author: J1165SOmichaeln

title: Getting to know Seville comfortably
text: A totally recommendable way to get to know Seville, it is worth it. The bicycles were perfectly maintained and they have a great variety of models. Marta, the guide who accompanied us, was very professional and super pleasant. We will repeat without a doubt.
author: 582rafaelp

title: Bike tour of Seville
text: Richard was an excellent guide. First he and bike shop took time to explain great E-bike.  Richard was very knowledgeable and personable. We saw a lot of Seville and he took the time to answer our questions.
author: OnAir46562194916

title: Great way to see many parts of Sevilla!
text: Richard was an awesome guide who took us around to see many unique parts of Seville. He was very knowledgeable and funny as well. He tailored the bike tour to places we had not yet experienced in Seville. Would highly recommend this bike tour with Richard for anyone visiting.
author: Susan_B

title: E-bikes around Seville
text:
A Fantastic Way to Discover Seville!

What a brilliant way to explore the beautiful city of Seville! Our 2.5-hour e-bike tour, booked through Viator, was an absolute pleasure from start to finish.

Our guide, Richard, was excellent – incredibly knowledgeable, engaging and full of fascinating information about Seville’s history, architecture and culture. He really brought the city to life, making the whole experience both informative and thoroughly enjoyable.

author: Glenn_W

title: Superb tour
text: It was a fantastic tour, with great quality bikes and the guide was superb. The perfect way to start a weekend in Seville!
author: R1922BCpaulm

title: Excellent way to see Seville
text:
We had a great experience on the Seville bike tour and thought it was well worth both the time and the money.

Richard was an excellent guide. He took us to some of the most visually impressive areas of Seville while also providing interesting background on the city’s history and culture. The pace made it easy to enjoy the surroundings without feeling rushed.

title: Great tour
text: Richard was an excellent guide and pitched it just right. The tour covers quite a lot of the key sights and the pace was good. The bikes were all in good condition and the route felt safe. We would recommend this tour.
